titulo: A Study to Assess the Safety and Efficacy of Alefacept in Kidney Transplant Recipients

braco.texto: Participants received alefacept administered as a 7.5 mg intravenous (IV) bolus on Days 0 and 3; 15 mg subcutaneously on Day 7 then weekly (QW) for 12 weeks, then 15 mg subcutaneously monthly until the end of month 6, in addition to tacrolimus at a starting dose of 0.10 mg/kg/day, MMF 750 or 1000 mg BID and tapered corticosteroids for 6 months.

titulo: A Study to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of Alefacept in Kidney Transplant Recipients

braco.texto: Participants received 7.5 mg alefacept administered intra-operatively as an IV bolus on Day 0, another 7.5 mg IV bolus on Day 3, and weekly subcutaneous injections of 15 mg alefacept thereafter for 12 weeks. Participants also received tacrolimus, MMF and steroid treatment.
braco.textoPt: Os participantes receberam 7,5 mg de alefacept administrado no intraoperatório como um bolus IV no Dia 0, outro bolus IV de 7,5 mg no Dia 3 e injeções subcutâneas semanais de 15 mg de alefacept depois disso por 12 semanas. Os participantes também receberam tratamento com tacrolimus, MMF e esteróides.
